title: HCC May 2024 - The Provision of Multi Supplier Framework for Property Works 2024 - 2028 - AWARD
description:
Hertfordshire County Council (hereinafter referred to as the Council) are out to tender for The Provision of Multi Supplier Framework for Property Works 2024 - 2028.
      
      The Council's Property Team delivers building and construction projects for the Council's portfolio which includes schools, libraries, fire service buildings, adult care service buildings, Rural Estate and the Council's offices. 
      
      In addition, the Framework is open to use by all District and Borough Councils within Hertfordshire, namely: Stevenage Borough Council, Three Rivers District Council, Dacorum Borough Council, Watford Borough Council, St Albans City and District Council, North Hertfordshire District Council, Hertsmere Borough Council, Borough of Broxbourne, East Herts Council, Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council, Hertfordshire Constabulary and all Schools within Hertfordshire.
      
      The Framework is divided into five Lots as listed below - 
      
      Lot 1 - Asbestos Removal
      Lot 2 - Roofing
      Lot 3 - Window Walling
      Lot 4 - Heating, Cooling, Ventilation and Electrical
      Lot 5 - Refurbishment, Adaptation, Extensions, Retrofit and New Build
      
      Full details are in the tender document set.

title: Provision of Support and Accommodation for Adults Experiencing Homelessness and Multiple Disadvantage - St Albans
description:
This is an Award Notice for the Provision of Support and Accommodation for Adults Experiencing Homelessness and Multiple Disadvantage - St Albans. This is a direct award because competition is absent for technical reasons.

The Service will be free at the point of use and will support single adults aged 18 and over experiencing homelessness and multiple disadvantage in St Albans The provider will make available 70 Units of support combination of accommodation based support and floating support as needed to be used flexibly 
Services will be focussed to target support to the following groups 
•	High/complex/multiple needs: i.e. Long-term rough sleepers or people encountering repeat homelessness and requiring intensive support through Housing First or supported housing with high-level of management and support. 

•	Medium/high needs: people with fluctuating levels of support, who are experiencing homelessness/rough sleeping and/or who have health, care and support needs best met through a housing-led placement with sufficient support. 

This Service will deliver a strengths based and trauma informed approach to support. The keyworker will listen to and understand the person's priorities, focussing on their personal goals and how they can be supported to live a full, healthy, active, and independent life.
